critical.title: ⚡ STRUCTURAL — Binance hack: ~$6.3B drained from 17 hot wallets
critical.text: Between 20:04 and 23:56 UTC on 10/29 attackers drained ~$6.3B across nine chains (Ethereum ~$3.8B). ~$2.7B was frozen (Tether ~$1.76B, Circle ~$823M, Arbitrum rescue); ~$3.2B remained with the attacker at 06:43 UTC 10/30, mostly ETH and BTC, with no transfer to exchanges or mixers yet. Binance cites a compromised engineer laptop, says no private keys leaked, has paused withdrawals (deposits open) and will cover losses from SAFU. BTC fell to $76,443, CoinGlass shows ~$1.54B liquidated (~$1.30B longs). Lens impact: 🔴 Adoption/Reserve and Fogle Technical; composite unchanged at NEUTRAL/LOW.
